title: Private participant profiles and clearer room controls
changes: Choose a guest name or connect your Nostr account before asking to join a hosted room.
Guests can change their name in Room info. The room sees the change straight away.
Share your own signed Nostr profile and an optional photo through the encrypted room.
Meeting hosts can mute a participant and move them to the audience, or remove them from the room.
Start sharing your screen from chat with your microphone and camera off.
